title: 时间轴 · 卡点
note: 时长和结构写在提示词里，没有滑杆。Clip 只有 30 秒，细时间轴请用这一页。
expected: 按秒进鼓、进副歌的短曲。

config.prompt:
Create a 60-second instrumental track at 80 BPM. The feeling is nostalgic, introspective, and atmospheric.

[0:00 - 0:12] Intro: soft Fender Rhodes chords, warm reverb. Intensity: 1/10 (Very Low)
[0:12 - 0:24] Verse 1: laid-back drum beat, ethereal synth pad, subtle sub-bass. Intensity: 3/10 (Low)
[0:24 - 0:36] Build: syncopated hi-hat, warm rounded synth lead. Intensity: 5/10 (Medium)
[0:36 - 0:48] Chorus: pull back; Rhodes groove and drums only. Intensity: 4/10 (Medium-Low)
[0:48 - 1:00] Outro: drums and bass drop out, fade on Rhodes. Intensity: 2/10 (Very Low)
